findings.title: Client-rendered one-pager: services have no URLs

evidence.quote: 1,191-byte HTML shell
#services, #our-approach

findings.why: The site cannot rank for 'branding agency Oman' or 'performance marketing Muscat'.
findings.fix: Pre-render (vite-plugin-ssg or Astro) and give each service and industry its own route with unique copy.

findings.title: Slogan title and description shared with the Outdoor site

evidence.quote: M21 Global — Transforming Ideas Into Success

findings.fix: Title: 'Media 21 | Full-Service Marketing Agency in Muscat, Oman'; write a distinct 150-char description.

findings.title: 56 client logos use filenames as alt text

evidence.quote: Eicher_Motors-Logo.wine.png
Ahlibank.png

findings.fix: Generate alt from a brand-name map (alt="Ahlibank"); mark the duplicated marquee copies aria-hidden.

findings.title: No on-site case studies; portfolio is a Drive PDF

evidence.quote: https://drive.google.com/file/d/19KJ-sSMCn9Kk7bymoFQVCNkODjdPQqxk/view

findings.fix: Publish 3 case pages (one per key industry: banking, automotive, real estate) with brief, work and result.

findings.title: Share image is the bolt.new template default

evidence.quote: https://bolt.new/static/og_default.png

findings.why: Every WhatsApp/LinkedIn share shows a third-party placeholder.
findings.fix: Set og:image to a branded 1200x630 image; set og:title/description and a canonical URL.

findings.title: Contact form inputs have no labels

evidence.quote: placeholder 'Your name' only; 4 unlabeled fields

findings.fix: Add <label for> (visually hidden if needed) or aria-label to each input.

findings.title: Services are one-line blurbs

evidence.quote: Public Relations: Building visibility, credibility, and meaningful conversations around brands.

findings.title: No named leadership or team

evidence.quote: We are a team of individuals who are dedicated to growing, nurturing and sustaining brands.

findings.title: Copy is about Media 21, not the client's problem
